papers.title_en: A Transformer-based Approach for Real-time Multi-agent Path Planning with Varying Initial/Final Conditions
papers.authors: Qian Zhang, Shanqing Liu, Jerome Darbon, George Karniadakis
papers.evidence: 带智能体间避碰约束的实时多智能体路径规划
papers.tldr: 多智能体在指定初末构型下的实时路径规划是一个带碰撞与障碍约束的高维最优控制问题，传统HJB/PMP求解器随智能体数量增长而难以计算。作者提出OCFormer，用Transformer参数化一个坐标变换的逆映射，把解耦的潜空间映射到耦合的物理空间，并以PMP哈密顿ODE残差加边界匹配的物理信息损失无监督训练。模型在单次前向约220ms内为未见过的初末条件生成近最优轨迹，支持最多128个智能体，并可用L-BFGS在数秒内迁移适配分布外扰动。
papers.abstract_en: We address the problem of real-time multi-agent path planning under prescribed initial and final configurations, formulated as a high-dimensional optimal control problem subject to inter-agent collision avoidance and obstacle constraints. Classical solvers based on the Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation or Pontryagin's maximum principle (PMP) become computationally intractable as the number of agents grows, due to the curse of dimensionality and the non-convexity introduced by interaction constraints. We propose OCFormer, a transformer-based neural network that parameterizes the inverse of a coordinate transformation mapping a simple, analytically tractable latent space, in which agents evolve independently under a decoupled Hamiltonian, to the physical space of the coupled, interacting system. The model is trained by minimizing a physics-informed loss comprising the Hamiltonian ODE residual from the PMP and a boundary matching term, without requiring pre-computed trajectory data. The self-attention mechanism endows OCFormer with permutation equivariance over agents, a structural symmetry that prior symplectic network approaches do not natively enforce. When trained on a distribution of boundary conditions, the amortized OCFormer produces near-optimal trajectories for unseen initial and final configurations in a single forward pass ($\sim$220ms), enabling real-time inference without retraining. We further introduce a lightweight transfer learning framework that adapts a pretrained OCFormer to out-of-distribution perturbations in seconds via L-BFGS fine-tuning. Numerical experiments on two- and three-dimensional multi-agent navigation with up to 128 agents demonstrate the scalability and efficiency of the proposed approach.

papers.title_en: Dispersive Tree Agreements for Multi-Robot Coordination
papers.authors: Shashank A. Deshpande, Blake T. Edwards, Jonathan P. How
papers.evidence: 去中心化实时多机器人协调近最优规划
papers.tldr: 多机器人非线性协调的联合最优控制通常依赖集中式离线规划，分散实时方法又难以逼近联合最优。本文把单机器人扩散树搜索扩展到多机，用局部约束替代机器人间耦合，并通过分散列生成与共享空间租金协商引导各机器人树搜索。协议WarpWeaver在滚动时域内异步实时运行，静默时认证近优性。仿真中总行程时间较集中离线规划最多降22%、较分散实时基线最多降37%，六机器人机载实验验证可行性。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-robot coordination of nonlinear systems is naturally formulated as joint-space optimal control subject to constraints over groups of robots. Existing methods that approach joint optimality remain largely centralized, offline, and confined to collision-free motion planning, while decentralized, real-time counterparts target safe navigation without pursuing the joint optimum. This paper develops a decentralized, real-time planner that approaches the joint optimum as an anytime process. We extend a recent single-robot framework that searches dispersive trees of forward-propagated commands for differentially flat systems to coordinate a multi-robot team near-optimally. We first show that the inter-robot coupling can be effectively replaced by some local constraints, under which locally grown dispersive trees contain a near-optimal agreement. It is this structure that the robots pursue by decentralized column generation, negotiating rents on the shared space that guide the search of each robot's tree. The negotiation settles on an agreement whose near-optimality is certified at quiescence. Our protocol, WarpWeaver, implements this negotiation as an asynchronous real-time loop over a receding horizon, and demonstrates effective closure to quiesced agreements even when real-time deadlines cut the negotiation short. In simulation, WarpWeaver reduces total travel time by up to 22% against centralized offline planners on the Dynobench suite and by up to 37% against a decentralized real-time baseline, and nearly doubles the success rate of a task-specific planner on graph connectivity. Hardware experiments on six robots planning onboard demonstrate real-world implementability.

papers.title_en: Extending Harmonic Function Methods via Root Locus for Coordinated Path Generation
papers.authors: Matteo Frascarelli, Lucia Pallottino, Alberto Landi
papers.evidence: 面向N个机器人和N个目标的协调路径生成
papers.tldr: 针对多边形障碍环境中N个可互换机器人与N个目标的离线协调路径生成，论文将起点和目标经共形映射化为有理函数的极点与零点，用广义根轨迹分支即对数势流线生成路径。除有限临界与边界相位外，各机器人沿互不相交且避障路径到达不同目标，分配由构造给出，并以增益为时钟实现同时到达。障碍经连续Milne-Thomson反射处理，有限反射下可验证实际计算势的安全性。该方法统一并推广了互惠根轨迹规划，在随机实例和多机器人场景中验证有效。
papers.abstract_en: We consider the offline generation of coordinated paths for N interchangeable robots and N goals in planar environments with polygonal obstacles. After a conformal map to a circular domain, starts and goals become the poles and zeros of a rational function R, and the paths are the branches of its Generalized Root Locus (GRL), i.e. the streamlines of the logarithmic potential -log R. We show that, for every phase outside a finite set of critical phases and a set of boundary phases, the induced gradient motion drives each robot to a distinct goal along pairwise disjoint paths that never reach the obstacles; the robot-goal assignment is produced by the construction, and with the gain used as a clock all robots move as the closed-loop roots of the GRL and arrive together at a prescribed time. Obstacles become streamlines through successive Milne-Thomson reflections, and for a finite number of reflections a finite test certifies safety for the potential that is actually computed. Reciprocal root-locus planning is recovered as a special case. The method is illustrated on two polygonal workspaces, 100 random instances compared with independent harmonic planning and artificial potentials, and a scene with ten robots and ten obstacles.

papers.title_en: Co^2Gen: Collaboratively Generating Task Plans for Decentralized Multi-Robot and Human Collaboration
papers.authors: Yi Loo, Siddhant Shrivastava, Minh Long Pham, Malika Meghjani
papers.evidence: 去中心化多机器人协同规划与数据生成
papers.tldr: VLA模型虽具跨本体与跨任务泛化潜力，但其多机器人及人机协作能力仍缺乏系统研究。Co^2Gen通过去中心化协作规划自动生成可执行的多机器人任务计划，并据此产出协作示范数据，以去中心化方式微调VLA模型，无需人工遥操作。实验表明，该方法微调的VLA在去中心化协作任务上达到与人类遥操作协作数据微调相当的任务表现。这为多机器人/人机协作VLA的数据生成与训练提供了可扩展方案。
papers.abstract_en: Visual Language Action (VLA) models are designed to be generalist robot models that can be implemented across embodiments, tasks and environments. However, their ability to collaborate with other robots and humans remains underexplored. In this work, we propose a framework to automate the generation of multi-robot collaborative data for decentralized VLA training without requiring human teleoperation. Our framework first utilizes a decentralized collaborative planning approach to generate multi-robot collaborative robot plans in the form of an executable function. We then utilize the collaborative plan to produce collaborative demonstration data to finetune VLA models in a decentralized manner. We show that our approach produces demonstration data that when used to finetune VLA models on decentralized collaboration tasks matches the task performance of VLA models finetuned on human-teleoperated collaborative data.

papers.title_en: Probabilistic Energy Modeling Unifies Versatile Swarm Control
papers.authors: Xiang Zhou, Xiangyu Zhu, Xintong Wang, Qingyuan Yang, Rui Huang, Feng Xue, Lin Li, Qingrui Zhang
papers.evidence: 通过可组合概率能量项统一群体控制
papers.tldr: 机器人集群需跨任务协调，但现有控制器在目标变化时常需重设计、调参或重训。该研究用概率能量建模统一集群控制，将基本行为编码为可复用能量项，并以轻量策略门控组合成单一控制器而无需重训。在无人机集群上，它零样本泛化到六类任务、10至100个智能体、两种平台及杂乱室内与拒止林地。大规模仿真成功率0.96至1.00、单智能体延迟1至10毫秒，实机部署验证了迁移能力。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic swarms must coordinate across diverse missions, yet existing controllers often require redesign, retuning, or retraining when objectives change. Here we show that probabilistic energy modeling provides a unifying representation for versatile swarm control, in which diverse missions emerge from compositions of shared interaction principles rather than task-specific control formulations. By exploiting the correspondence between Gibbs random field energy minimization and structured reward maximization, we encode fundamental swarm behaviors as reusable energy terms within a unified probabilistic objective. Decentralized policies trained within this representation are composed into a single controller through lightweight policy gating, without retraining. An interpretable action-attention mechanism captures non-uniform local interactions, while dimensionless normalization supports transfer across swarm scales and platforms. Demonstrated on aerial swarms, the unified policy generalizes zero-shot across six mission classes, 10-100 agents, two hardware platforms, and indoor cluttered and GPS-denied woodland environments. Large-scale simulations achieve 0.96-1.00 task success rates with 1-10 ms per-agent inference latency, while physical deployments confirm zero-shot transfer to real platforms and unstructured environments. These results establish probabilistic energy modeling as a scalable and transferable framework for decentralized swarm control.

papers.title_en: Skeleton-Grounded Latent Action Model for Robot World Models
papers.authors: Qi Lv, Jiayi Lin, Yuxin Jiang, Jianzong Wang, Xiang Deng, Mike Shou Zheng
papers.evidence: 机器人世界模型与骨架引导的潜在动作分解
papers.tldr: 机器人世界模型需从视频中学习动作驱动动态，但重建式潜在动作会把机器人运动与物体响应、场景变化混在一起，难以对应真实控制。SkeLAM用机器人骨架监督将潜在动作分解为运动学分量和残差视觉动态，并通过跨模态交换重建与分离条件通路增强可控性。在DROID上，末端执行器ADE降低19.5%、LPIPS降低11.1%，并展示零样本人到机器人动作迁移与策略评估一致性。
papers.abstract_en: Robot world models simulate how environments evolve in response to robot actions. Latent action models enable learning dynamics from videos by encoding visual transitions as proxy actions. However, reconstruction-driven latent actions mix robot motion with object responses and other scene changes, complicating their correspondence with robot controls. We propose SkeLAM, a skeleton-guided latent action model for controllable robot world modeling. SkeLAM decomposes latent actions into a kinematic component grounded by robot skeleton supervision and a residual component retaining complementary visual dynamics. Cross-modal swap reconstruction encourages RGB-derived and skeleton-derived kinematic representations to be interchangeable during video reconstruction. The world model incorporates both components through separate conditioning pathways, while branch dropout reduces its dependence on future-derived residual information. A lightweight adapter maps robot actions to the kinematic space, and subsequent world-model fine-tuning adapts generation to these predicted conditions. At inference, the model generates future observations from the current observation and robot actions. On DROID, SkeLAM reduces end-effector ADE by 19.5% and LPIPS by 11.1% compared with DreamDojo. Motion probing supports kinematic specialization, while qualitative results demonstrate zero-shot human-to-robot motion transfer in generated rollouts. Policy evaluation shows agreement between predicted success rates and those measured in real robot executions.

papers.title_en: Learning from Fleet Experience: Collective Experience Learning Across 96 Robots
papers.authors: Chao Yu, Shu'ang Yu, Hao Lin, Hongzhi Zang, Yuxiang Yan, Chenxi Jiang, Zhen Guo, Chuankang Li, Yihao Chen, Xin Xu, Xu Fu, Jiakai Zhou, Liangzhi Shi, Hongyi Ren, Yiwei Liu, Jing Wu, Yuanqing Wang, Chen Wu, Bo Dai, Chunyu Yang, Hongliang Huang, Shuoyu Yue, Weiqi Yin, Yinuo Chen, Ruihua Chen, Chunyang Zhu, Han Xiao, Yanghao Li, Ruipu Wu, Zhikai Cai, Xiu Chen, Xu Tan, Si Liu, Yuchen Yan, Jialin Zhang, Wen Zeng, Yiming Zhou, Zixiao Huang, Xinlei Chen, Guanghui Ren, Quanlu Zhang, Boxun Li, Maoqing Yao, Yu Wang
papers.evidence: 跨96台机器人机群的共享策略协同学习
papers.tldr: 机器人部署虽能产生可用于策略改进的经验，但持续依赖专家纠正动作使学习难以随机器人队伍扩张而规模化。作者提出集体经验学习CEL，让部署机器人汇总自身执行经验，更新并回传共享策略，并通过失败引导经验检索微调FERT实现，无需额外专家示范或纠正。在五项真实操作任务中成功率达93.3%-99.2%，96台机器人多阶段手机包装任务从79.2%提升至98.3%。这表明CEL可利用部署经验规模化提升策略可靠性。
papers.abstract_en: Robot deployment generates experience that can support policy improvement, but continued reliance on expert corrective actions makes learning difficult to scale across growing fleets. We propose learning from fleet experience: using deployed robots' own executions as a source of supervision for further policy improvement. We call this paradigm Collective Experience Learning (CEL), in which robots pool execution experience to update a shared policy that returns to the fleet. Following expert-supervised initialization, we realize CEL through failure-guided experience retrieval fine-tuning (FERT). FERT uses failure contexts to retrieve relevant segments from successful trajectories and prioritizes their recorded actions for supervised updates, without collecting additional expert demonstrations or corrective actions. Operators provide binary episode-outcome labels and environment resets. A fault-tolerant asynchronous training system (FATS) coordinates robot execution, cloud inference and policy optimization despite local interruptions. Across five real-world manipulation tasks, the resulting policies achieve success rates of 93.3-99.2%, evaluated over 120 trials per task on robots excluded from training data collection. With collection time per robot held fixed, larger fleets provide more experience and generally improve performance across the evaluated sizes. On multi-stage phone packaging, learning with 96 robots raises success from 79.2% to 98.3%. These results support CEL as a scalable approach to improving robot policy reliability through experience generated during deployment.

papers.title_en: SpecMAGIC: Specification-Guided Multi-Task Generalization in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Zijian Guo, İlker Işık, H. M. Sabbir Ahmad, Wenchao Li
papers.evidence: 跨智能体分配子任务的分层多智能体规划
papers.tldr: 多智能体强化学习中的多任务泛化尚缺乏系统研究，而现实应用要求智能体在具有复杂协调需求的长时序任务间泛化。作者提出结合时序逻辑任务规范与算子的规范语言，并构建分层框架SpecMAGIC，利用任务规范的自动机结构进行子任务分解。集中式高层规划器为各智能体分配兼容的子任务序列，去中心化低层策略执行单个子任务。实验表明该方法在未见任务规范上显著优于现有方法，并随智能体数量增加保持强性能。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-task generalization is an important yet underexplored problem in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL). Many real-world applications require multi-agent systems to generalize across complex, temporally extended tasks with diverse inter-agent coordination requirements. We introduce a specification language that combines temporal-logic task specifications with operators for expressing such requirements. We propose SpecMAGIC, a hierarchical framework that leverages the automaton structure of task specifications for subtask decomposition. A centralized high-level planner identifies and allocates compatible subtask sequences across agents, while decentralized low-level policies execute individual subtasks. This enables zero-shot generalization to new tasks by composing reusable subtask policies according to new specifications, without retraining. We establish soundness and probabilistic completeness of the high-level planner. Experiments on multi-agent navigation tasks show that SpecMAGIC substantially outperforms existing approaches on unseen task specifications and maintains strong performance as the number of agents increases.

papers.title_en: Continuous-Time Motion Planning and Steering with Global Convergence
papers.authors: Mohsen Amiri, Sima Didari, Davoud Ataee Tarzanagh, Hankyu Moon, Yeongdae Kwon
papers.evidence: 具全局收敛性的连续时间多机器人无碰撞运动规划
papers.tldr: 运动规划需在每一时刻满足约束，现有方法难以在平滑代价与连续约束下证明全局最优。论文将规划与策略引导统一为连续时间程序，提出基于分段多项式曲线梯度投影的 GlobMP，交替降低代价与恢复可行性。理论上随分段数增加，代价趋近全局最优且约束满足任意容差。实验在200机器人、Robotarium、迷宫及人形触觉策略引导中优于强基线。
papers.abstract_en: Motion planning is central to robotics, and it is increasingly used to correct the motions proposed by learned planners and policies. In both uses, constraints must hold at every instant of the motion, not only at sampled times. To our knowledge, no algorithm provably converges to a globally optimal motion once a smoothness cost is combined with such constraints. We cast planning and steering as a single continuous-time program: robots avoid one another and static or moving obstacles, and a learned proposal is steered by keeping the motion close to it. The program is elementary to state, yet nonconvex. We propose GlobMP (Global Motion Planning), a gradient projection method over piecewise-polynomial curves, on which each constraint is one polynomial per piece that must stay nonnegative over the whole motion; it alternates cost reduction with feasibility restoration. Under mild assumptions, we show that, from a fine grid start, its cost approaches the global optimum as the number of polynomial pieces grows, with every constraint met to any chosen tolerance, or exactly on stable instances. We demonstrate its superior performance over strong baselines in real and synthetic experiments, including teams of up to $200$ robots, multi-robot planning on the Robotarium testbed and an extended benchmark, maze navigation, and steering tactile-reactive policies on a bimanual humanoid.

papers.title_en: UniFlowWAM: A Unified World-Action Model with Visual Semantics and 4D Geometry
papers.authors: Jialin Tian, Zhuofan Li, Xinkai Wang, Bokai Lin, Chenyi Wang, Xinyu Zhan, Cewu Lu, Lixin Yang
papers.evidence: 融合4D场景流的统一机器人世界-动作模型
papers.tldr: 机器人示范只记录视觉与动作，缺少场景级3D变化，难以直接描述世界如何演化。UniFlowWAM把3D场景流提升为与视觉、动作并列的第三模态，用扩散Transformer三专家联合注意力建模，并让流获得独立监督。模型在十目标角色网格下训练，可统一充当策略、正逆动力学以及未来视觉特征和3D流预测器。在RoboCasa-GR1上成功率由52.1%升至56.4%，真实双臂任务平均87.0%，为策略提供更完整的4D几何世界表示。
papers.abstract_en: Robot demonstrations record what the robot saw and what it did. They do not specify how the 3D world changed in between. Scene-level 3D flow describes it by tracking 3D scene points, providing the world representation with 4D geometry. Prior work has used flow to improve robot policies. Flow served as an intermediate prediction that a separate model converts into actions, as a prior injected at inference time, or as an extra output learned together with the action. In all of these designs, flow stays outside the policy, as a separate module or as an extra prediction head. We introduce UniFlowWAM, a Unified World-Action Model that makes 3D scene flow a third modality on par with vision and action. Its world representation therefore covers both visual semantics, through future visual features, and 4D geometry, through 3D flow, and flow receives its own supervision. UniFlowWAM is a diffusion transformer with one expert per modality, and the three experts exchange information through joint attention. We train UniFlowWAM under a ten-objective role grid, where each objective assigns every modality exactly one of three roles, namely target, condition, or absent. The same model thus serves as a policy, as forward and inverse dynamics, and as a predictor of future visual features or 3D flow. We evaluate UniFlowWAM on RoboCasa-GR1, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus in simulation, and on four real-world bimanual manipulation tasks. On RoboCasa-GR1, UniFlowWAM raises the success rate of its base model without flow from 52.1% to 56.4%. It preserves in-distribution success on LIBERO at 98.1% and reaches 87.7% zero-shot on LIBERO-Plus. On the real robot, it achieves 87.0% average success, compared with 68.5% for the strongest baseline.

papers.title_en: Consistent Distributed Invariant EKF SLAM with Point and Object Features
papers.authors: Mengya Xu, Xianjia Yu, Ha Sier, Shoudong Huang, Tomi Westerlund
papers.evidence: 面向多机器人协同的分布式SLAM地图融合
papers.tldr: 多机器人SLAM可通过交换地图提升估计，但重复交换引入未知相关性；RI-EKF中点特征误差与邻居位姿耦合，使邻居地图无法直接经CI融合。本文提出Joint-CI，在接收机器人误差坐标下联合重建位姿与共同特征并保留机器人—特征及特征—特征相关性，再用部分状态CI融合。理论证明融合保持六个不可观测方向与一阶协方差一致性；仿真和真实数据实验显示精度提升且不确定性一致、轻度保守。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-robot SLAM allows robots to improve their estimates by exchanging map information, but repeated exchanges create unknown correlations between local estimators. Covariance intersection (CI) can fuse estimates without tracking these correlations. In right-invariant extended Kalman filter (RI-EKF) SLAM, however, point features obtain their invariant errors through the robot rotation, so a neighbor's map estimate is expressed in its own error coordinates and is correlated with its pose, and cannot be fused by CI directly. This paper presents Joint-CI, a unified fusion method for distributed RI-EKF SLAM with point, object, and mixed point--object maps. Using a neighboring robot's local posterior and an inter-robot observation, a joint estimate of the receiving robot's pose and the common features is constructed in the receiving robot's error coordinates, retaining the robot--feature and feature--feature correlations. Partial-state CI then fuses this estimate with the receiving robot's local posterior. We show that the unified formulation and the fusion preserve the six unobservable directions associated with global rotation and translation, and that communication and fusion preserve first-order covariance consistency given consistent local posteriors. Monte Carlo simulations and a real-world dataset-derived experiment show that Joint-CI improves estimation accuracy while maintaining consistent, mildly conservative uncertainty.
